facts.fact: A University of Sao Tome and Principe master's dissertation, reported by Tela Non, used national DHIS2 system data for 2022-2023 to compare hypertension, diabetes and stroke incidence across districts including Agua Grande, Lemba, Me-Zochi, Lobata and Principe.

UNDP Sao Tome and Principe published a notice (UNDP-STP-00136) on 29 April 2026 for a one-month independent evaluation of the country's health digitisation project, covering the effectiveness and sustainability of the DHIS2, mSupply and Instalacoes Inteligentes systems.

note: Only states STP's PNDS 2023-2032 and no standalone digital instrument; names no health information system.
Names the national system but does not say facilities report through it; the link to civil registration is in development.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health of Sao Tome and Principe says DHIS2 is the main health data management platform at country level, with training given in January 2024 to district statistician interns and epidemiology students.

note: The document states nothing this study asks.
No health information system is described.
Computerisation of one hospital's services; no national health reporting system stated.
A local network for one hospital; no national health reporting system stated.
